releaseTarget: Qwen parity across every benchmark workload

owners.task: Integrate active-evidence retrieval, language/chat realization, and general program synthesis

rules: Root owns priority, integration, and the only full validation gate
All source changes land directly on main; do not create branches or worktrees
One shared server lock exists for live measurement and integration checks
No runtime model calls; local model use is development assistance only
A passing local test is not a measured benchmark improvement
Workers prove their change; integrators prove the system
Excessive validation is a swarm defect because it consumes shared compute

localWorkerTrial.reason: Suggested removing valid selectors and produced truncated recursive output

validation.worker: focused: directly affected test or bounded diagnostic only; target under 60 seconds
validation.skeptic: focused adversarial regression against the causal claim
validation.domainLead: subsystem gate after a related batch
validation.integration: root only: build and full suite after a meaningful batch
validation.benchmarkOwner: root only: live server, head-to-head, and release gates
